svg.aria-label: A Signal reads a support agent's trace with the prompt 'Did the agent decline to do all or part of what the user asked?'. The user says picture messages won't send; the agent looks up the account, then calls transfer_to_human_agents saying its tools are unavailable, and tells the user they are being transferred. The Signal records an event: declined_part 'MMS troubleshooting', reason_given 'capability', severity warning.
